summary.deleteAllPlayers: Delete all characters of the "Player" type

warnings.campaignDelete: The campaign and all dependent records will be deleted.
warnings.characterManual: Background equipment and gold stay manual; additionalSpells is not supported.
warnings.serverRoll: The server rolls the dice once during execution; the result is not known yet.
warnings.contentCascades: The current cascades and reference rules will apply. A change in dependencies cancels the proposal.
warnings.sourceApply: Dependencies are added automatically; attribution is updated for ignore too. The DM's ScenarioPage materials are not synced.
warnings.importPartial: The import may complete partially: errors and skips are returned for each row.
warnings.manualSetup: additionalSpells, equipment and gold are set up manually.
warnings.importPartialDone: The import completed partially; check the row errors in the report.
warnings.battleDice: Dice and random effects are computed only at execution time; the result is not known yet.
warnings.battleClearHistory: All battles of the campaign will be deleted together with their events and snapshots.
warnings.battleManualDice: The roll values explicitly set by the DM are used.

effects.skillTreeReplace: Tree replacement, keeping the current progress carry-over

handoffs.compendium-read: View the permitted reports and import options through your own session in the app.
handoffs.credentials: Add or change the provider key in the AI settings.
handoffs.tokens: Manage API tokens and their permissions in the app.
handoffs.invite: Review the campaign invitation and pass it to the person yourself.
handoffs.campaign-import: Choose a local file in the campaign creation form.
handoffs.campaign-join: Enter the invitation code in the campaign join dialog.
handoffs.content-import: Choose a file, check the mapping and confirm the import in the existing editor.
handoffs.ai-map: Pick the data and run AI mapping in the import dialog.
handoffs.slide-upload: Choose an image in the slide deck editor.
handoffs.track-upload: Choose an audio file in the music library.
handoffs.player-draft: The player's draft and AI features are available only in the player's own flow.
handoffs.compendium-preview: Choose a local JSON file, check the preview and confirm your rights to the materials in the app.
handoffs.compendium-confirm: Open the current preview, check the selection and confirm your import rights in the app.
handoffs.source-notes: The DM must explicitly pick the source notes before they are passed to AI. Notes are never passed automatically.
handoffs.campaignExport: Download the campaign export in the app; its content is not sent to the model.
handoffs.contentMedia: Add the icon or file in the existing editor, then repeat the change of the other fields without media.
handoffs.battleCritChoice: The DM picks the crit effect, "Random" or cancels the action in the battle dialog; other battle commands are rejected until then.
handoffs.battleMapBackground: Add the image in the map editor; after saving, its link can be used.

media.icon: Add the icon in the existing content editor
media.trackFile: Upload the file in the music library

rules.condition-usage: Where a custom condition is used

blocks.readAloud: {count, plural, one {# read-aloud block} other {# read-aloud blocks}}
blocks.say: {count, plural, one {# line of dialogue} other {# lines of dialogue}}

scenarioOps.sectionMissing: Section {id} is not on the page
scenarioOps.rowMissing: Row {id} is not in the section "{section}"
scenarioOps.lossyRow: Row {id} contains markup that AI cannot reproduce without loss (nested lists or complex tables) — edit it manually
scenarioOps.removal: The edit removes from row {id}: {lost}. replaceRow replaces the whole field — carry these blocks into the new text unchanged, or pass allowRemoval: true only if the DM explicitly asked to remove them.
